requirements: Requires FTK Mod Framework 1.1.0 or later within major version 1. Restart the game after installation or removal.
Final smaller-hand model verified in Hunter character selection, overworld and an ordinary starting-bow attack on macOS.
Other class layouts, armor changes, other weapons, hit and death animations, save/reload, and online co-op are unverified.
contentChanges: Choose Possum alongside the native character appearances.
An original faceted possum model with a pointed muzzle, rounded ears and a long pink tail.
Keep your class abilities, stats and native equipment.
The tail follows the body; it has no independent animation.
changelog: 1.0.0: Original cosmetic Possum race, faceted model and texture, smaller palms and fingers, and fourteen native class bindings.
